action_summary: All four creature entry points defaulted to `life=40.0` against an attempt cost of 1.0, and `Life` has no earn or credit method, so a creature got exactly FORTY attempts for its entire existence. Its own predictor refuses to issue a verdict below MIN_SETTLED=20 settled predictions, so it was granted ten times the minimum sample, spent it inside four or five sessions, and then sat alive and permanently unable to act: `can_finish` false for every obligation, every later session a no-op reporting a cumulative counter. Measured, same creature and board, only the grant changed: life 40 -> 40 attempts / skill +0.465; 160 -> 162 / +0.671; 480 -> 201 / +0.681, CALIBRATED at every grant. A single named `DEFAULT_LIFE_GRANT` now carries the value so a runner cannot silently re-starve it.
ambiguous_after_this_change: Whether the previous lead-reversion is affected: skill at a fed grant is +0.68 CALIBRATED, while earlier measurements of '-0.084 WORSE_THAN_BASE_RATE' and the sign-error-across-families diagnosis were taken at grant 40. Those conclusions are therefore PROVISIONAL and must be re-taken at the new default before anything is built on them. This is step 2 of the plan and is deliberately not folded into this change.
blocker_lease_key: 2026-10-09-resource-bounded-bytes-v1::GENERAL_REUSABLE_PROBLEM_SOLVING_CAPABILITY_FRONTIER::Five measured architectural gaps remained on `4f479886` after PR #6599: (1) `tree_sitter_cst_skill_skeleton_v1` whitelisted only 5 node shapes (returning `None` on general calls, subscripts, attributes, ternaries), `ConfinedLanguageTestOracle` raised `RUNNER_ARGV_REQUIRED_FOR_LANGUAGE` on `.ts`/`.rs`/`.go`/`.cpp`, and `recall_and_apply_verified` blocked cross-repo `TEST_SUITE` transfer unless `scope_id` matched verbatim; (2) `brokered_workspace_execution_v1` + `ConfinedLanguageTestOracle` copied full directory trees 4x-7x on `publish=False` verification and `recall_and_apply_verified` never pre-screened candidates via `ZygotePrewarmedPool`; (3) `AwakeAgencyDaemon.pulse()` stamped obligation IDs with `_pulse_count` and cleared `Creature._board` every pulse, preventing `max_attempts=2` parking and spending `0.5` `Life` (`185 ms`) on green workspaces; (4) `UpstreamRoutingLedger`, `macro_v1`, `forged_binding_and_macro_spine_v1` (including `_MACRO_MEM_CACHE`), `rule_expiry_v1`, R3 queue callers, and `live_integrated_brain_v1.run_raw_goal` lacked complete `MemoryPolicy` (`OFF`/`READ_ONLY`/`READ_WRITE`) gates; (5) `self_falsify_and_narrow_rule_scopes()` hardcoded `('<=', '<')` without persisting `learned_scope`, and `UpstreamRoutingLedger` lacked `N >= 2` verified positive route promotion with miss invalidation.
causal_blocker: The creature was being graded on learning under a budget that made learning impossible, and three consecutive turns of investigation concluded 'the learning loop does not work' from measurements taken inside that budget.
expected_parent_change: The creature reaches its own calibration verdict with headroom instead of dying on the minimum sample, and a session that ends can be followed by a session that still has something to spend.
expected_parent_frontier_change: Provenance becomes a function of execution rather than of import: the population of UNKNOWN rules shrinks by re-verification instead of by declaration. The existing STALE skip now has something to bite on, since a stamp can disagree with the current world.
explicit_user_authorization: Owner: 'go' on step 1 of FIRST_PRINCIPLES_FOUR_20261104_V1.md, with the falsifier pre-committed: 'skill must clear +0.65 and parked must shrink from 89 without any code change to the organs. If raising the budget does not move those, the starvation hypothesis is wrong and I will say so.' Result reported as measured: skill clears +0.65 (it passes), parked does NOT shrink (it fails), so the hypothesis is half-confirmed and max_attempts was reverted rather than shipped.
falsification_condition: Set DEFAULT_LIFE_GRANT back to 40.0 and re-run `canonical/tests/test_the_creature_is_not_starved_v1.py`: measured 2026-11-04, `test_the_default_grant_covers_more_than_the_predictor_needs` fails ('40.0 not greater than 100'). The other three tests bind the runners to the named constant, so a runner that hardcodes 40.0 again fails too.
known_deferred_defect: The 19 adapters still default to a fixed `canonical/tmp_*.json`. The creature's sampler always supplies output_path so it is unreachable in practice, but a direct caller that omits it collides across concurrent runs. Rewriting them to use a per-run temp directory is the follow-up and is not done here, because it is 19 adapter edits with no capability gain over this change.
